caption: The drawing depicts a metal candlestick holder with two curved arms, each supporting a candle. The holder stands on a tripod base with three outwardly splayed feet, each foot ending in a flat, rounded pad. The central stem is vertically oriented, elongated, and extends upwards where the top curves into a hook-like feature. Both candle arms originate from the middle section of the stem and curve outward and upward, each terminating in a round candle plate that holds a single, upright candle. The candles themselves are depicted as straight, pale, and cylindrical with visible wicks. The overall color scheme is shades of gray on a lightly tinted beige background, typical of pencil or graphite on paper. A small scale marked in inches is located at the bottom left corner. The artist's signature, "CARL WEISS," is present in the lower right corner of the drawing. The composition is centered on the paper, with the object placed upright, showing all components clearly.
title: Candlestand
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
